description: List the online stores in the holdmark registry, with a summary of their published facts. Each store publishes the same facts under the same rules: whether it delivers its orders (checked with the carrier) and whether it refunds money (checked with the payment processor). holdmark does not rank stores and has no score, so compare them yourself by whatever the person actually cares about. The registry only contains stores that connected their data. A store missing from it has not been judged.

category.description: Filter by the category the merchant declared. Declared, not checked: it says what a store sells, not how it behaves.

limit.description: How many to return. Default 50, maximum 100.

meets_limits.description: Only stores that meet (or do not meet) the published limits.

offset.description: Skip this many, to page through the list.

sort.description: Field to order by. Default: domain (alphabetical).

name: find_stores
title: Find stores in the holdmark registry
